spec: SELECTION_V2.md controls; CPU float32 re-run of the banked M2b checkpoints; windows = the 4 of viz/out/selection.json, seeds M2b_s0 / M2b_s1

control_1_own_nav_all_layers_reproduces_.note: B's own-code plan = model.forward_infer on the window. The chain (run_s -> run_t -> run_o with nav replaced) with the window's own nav at S, T and O, and with no override, is bit-identical to it at all 8 window-seed pairs: the injection harness changes nothing by itself.

info_cpu_rerun_vs_banked_gpu.unit: metres (max abs over the 8 window-seed pairs); note: banked ckpt npz is in S's TICK frame, compared in that frame

control_2_drawn_plans_equal_banked_perwi.note: H/HS/B/P10 as drawn are the arrays read from hblend/hspec score_*_perwindow.npz (B = kind-own `tau`, P10 = `P`), at window indices taken from selection.json; ADE6 recomputed from the drawn arrays against GT equals the banked per-window ade6 (<= 3.5e-7 m).

control_3_frame_alignment_as_v1.note: Cache step j = native frame 2j; each of the 101 steps of the 4 clips was re-encoded and its DINOv3 feature argmax-matched against the banked cache (v1, `viz/out/align_control.json`); v2 draws frames with the SAME accessor (v2_lib.v2ep_frame) and the SAME step index. Not re-run in v2 (identical inputs, identical accessor).

control_4_zeroed_e_nav_structural_zero.note: e_nav.weight zeroed => the nav embedding is a constant; D6, D6_TURN_L/R, lat_sep and LR_dist must read EXACTLY 0.0 at every injection point (identity, not an estimate).

pre_declaration.note: SELECTION_V2.md was written before any run and has not been edited since (mtime precedes every output; sha256 recorded at the time of this merge).
